concerns.text: FR-006 (independent hold-out set) and SC-004 (learning curve analysis) lack a complete execution task. T020a is marked 'FAILED: unspecified' and only describes logic for splitting or config generation. There is no task explicitly defined to *execute* the learning curve analysis (training on subsamples) if N < 50, nor to *execute* the hold-out split and save the indices if N >= 50. The plan requires this execution to proceed to T020b.

FR-005, FR-007, FR-008, FR-009, FR-012, and SC-001/002/003/005 are unimplemented. Tasks T020c (Feature Importance), T021a (Correlations), T021b (Permutation), T021d (Sensitivity), and T022 (VIF) are all marked 'FAILED: unspecified' or missing execution steps. While T020b (Training) is marked [X], the downstream tasks required to satisfy the validation requirements (permutation, sensitivity, VIF) are not executable as written.

FR-002, FR-004, and FR-013 (Preprocessing/Harmonization) are blocked. T017a is marked 'FAILED: unspecified'. Without a successful execution of T017a, the `batch_corrected_matrix.csv` and `labels.csv` required for all downstream US2 and US3 tasks cannot be produced.

FR-010 (Pathway Mapping) and FR-011 (Associational Framing) are blocked. T026a depends on T020c (which failed). T026b, T026c, T027, and T028 are marked 'FAILED: unspecified' or lack execution logic. No task exists to actually generate the `pathway_analysis.json` or the visualization `pathway_barplot.png`.

T024 claims to be the 'sole writer' of `results/shap_analysis.json` but the task description lists it as reading `results/correlation_analysis_raw.json` (from T021a) and `results/feature_importance_ranking.json` (from T020c). Since T021a and T020c are marked failed/missing, T024 has no inputs. The task needs to be redefined to include the execution of the aggregation logic or the upstream tasks must be fixed.

T013 is marked [ ] (unchecked) but the description includes 'Exit 1 only if NO studies are verified'. This creates a potential pipeline halt that contradicts the 'unverified' warning logic described in the text. The task needs to be marked [X] (if implemented) or the logic clarified to ensure it doesn't block the pipeline unnecessarily if some studies are unverified.
